_what: What a BANKED element must hold before production may use it. Read by machine/elements_check.py; explained in PRODUCTION-ELEMENTS.md. Built 2026-09-23 on the owner's word ('everything needs to be dialed in … every single line of execution is literally fool proof') from the film continuity, animation model-sheet and current AI-video reference traditions (sources in PRODUCTION-ELEMENTS.md). Change a row here and every run is held to it — no code change.

requires.name: character file
requires.why: the breakdown: age, look, load-bearing details, movement, voice notes — the paste-ready identity block

requires.name: master
requires.why: front, flat light, plain wall — the ONE identity image every generation starts from

requires.name: turnaround
requires.why: full body front · three-quarter · profile · back — the body from every side

requires.name: angles and expressions
requires.why: head and shoulders: front, both three-quarters, profile, up, down; neutral, smile, mid-word, concern, laugh — what a talking face needs

requires.name: looks
requires.why: one full-body sheet per outfit, front and back, with its continuity notes — the costume bible

requires.name: details
requires.why: hands both sides, the load-bearing skin, jewellery — the macro truth

requires.name: light test
requires.why: the same face in daylight, warm indoor and overcast — so the identity holds in every setting's light

requires.name: colour key
requires.why: hair, skin, eyes and each outfit as swatches sampled from the master and looks — the colour lock

requires.name: looks list
requires.why: the looks a brief may name, each with its outfit words and sheet

requires.name: real reference
requires.why: EVERYTHING STARTS FROM A REAL REFERENCE (the owner, 2026-09-23) — a real photo or real video frame this element was made from; nothing is generated from words alone

requires.name: provenance
requires.why: EVERY ELEMENT DOCUMENTED — each real reference with its source and rights, the model/door/prompt that made each picture, where the full-size files live on the Drive, which runs used it

voice.rule: every person who speaks has their OWN designed voice — never another character's

motion.rule: performance references (real human clips) for motion transfer — required only when a scene names `motion.reference`

requires.name: set file
requires.why: what the place is, time of day, light direction, set dressing, hero props, what resets, room tone

requires.name: establishing plate
requires.why: the whole space, empty, in its shooting light

requires.name: camera angles
requires.why: at least two: the to-camera position and the cutaway position, empty

requires.name: real reference
requires.why: EVERYTHING STARTS FROM A REAL REFERENCE (the owner, 2026-09-23) — a real photo or real video frame this element was made from; nothing is generated from words alone

requires.name: provenance
requires.why: EVERY ELEMENT DOCUMENTED — each real reference with its source and rights, the model/door/prompt that made each picture, where the full-size files live on the Drive, which runs used it

requires.name: product file
requires.why: what it is, the label text word for word

requires.name: real packshot
requires.why: the real photograph — it IS the real reference; a product is never drawn from words

requires.name: provenance
requires.why: EVERY ELEMENT DOCUMENTED — each real reference with its source and rights, the model/door/prompt that made each picture, where the full-size files live on the Drive, which runs used it

requires.name: prop file
requires.why: what it is, where it came from, which ads used it

requires.name: prop picture
requires.why: what it looks like, so it is the same object every shot

requires.name: real reference
requires.why: EVERYTHING STARTS FROM A REAL REFERENCE (the owner, 2026-09-23) — a real photo or real video frame this element was made from; nothing is generated from words alone

requires.name: provenance
requires.why: EVERY ELEMENT DOCUMENTED — each real reference with its source and rights, the model/door/prompt that made each picture, where the full-size files live on the Drive, which runs used it

brief._motion: flip to true when real-motion (performance transfer) becomes the default; until then a scene MAY name motion.reference
brief._speaker: Every scene with words names its `speaker` — a cast id — and every speaking cast member names their `voice`: a banked voice, or NEW with a persona so the elements step makes it (the owner, 2026-09-23: 'if you need a second voice that should be clearly identified at the brief level').

provenance_rules._what: What provenance.json must say, checked field by field by elements_check.py

_rule_real_reference: Every element — person, look, setting, product, prop, voice, movement — is processed FROM A REAL REFERENCE (the owner, 2026-09-23: 'ALL elements in this flow must be processed from a real reference'). A generated picture may be a reference for the next generation only if it traces back, in its provenance, to a real one.
_rule_documented: Every element is documented (the owner, 2026-09-23: 'seriously every element documented'): a readable file (character.md / set.md / product.md / prop.md) and a provenance.json. An element without both is not banked.
_homes: Generated elements live in runs (casting for people and their voices, ai-elements/<kind>/ for everything else); brands/<brand>/ holds only brand facts — the real products and the cast list (the owner, 2026-09-23). element_paths.py is the one place the paths are written.

person_voice_only._what: A person the brief never shows (in no scene's `who`) but who speaks — e.g. an off-camera moderator. Only their voice is ever made (the owner, 7 Oct: standardize so a finished ad has a full manifest).

requires.name: character file
requires.why: who they are and how they sound

requires.name: voice
requires.why: their own voice id — every speaker reads in their own voice

person_background._what: A person or group the brief only ever shows from behind, out of focus or as a crowd — never a readable face. Marked by `"shown": "background"` in the folder's spec.json or provenance.json. A face sheet set would be made for nothing.

requires.name: character file
requires.why: who they are and how they are shown

requires.name: look sheet
requires.why: what they wear, front and back — for a person never seen face-on this sheet IS the identity picture every generation starts from

requires.name: provenance
requires.why: every element documented

product_kit._what: When the brand keeps its product as a flat file (brands/<brand>/products/<id>.md) rather than a folder, the product is checked against its truth kit — the real shape, size and photos production measures against (THE-CHAIN.md, 'Products have a truth kit'). The kit is found by the brief's product id: products/<id>/, or the one kit folder named <id>-*.

requires.name: kit record
requires.why: the measured shape, colours and label of the real product

requires.name: real packshot
requires.why: the real photograph — a product is never drawn from words
